body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and Suburban Directory for 1873.
A copy of the full directory is held by Melbourne History Resources, and you can read it online.

The 1873 directory has its own Carlton section, under North Melbourne (pp. 86–114), covering the area east of the Elizabeth-street extension within Park-street, Victoria-street east, Nicholson-street and Flemington-road, including North Carlton. Streets are listed in alphabetical order, each side house by house, with the cross streets in order. All of the section is included here. Rathdowne and Berkeley streets are stored as Rathdown and Berkley streets, and Neil-street as Neill Street, to match the later years.
The project covers the area south of Grattan Street, west of Swanston Street, east of Elizabeth Street and north of Victoria Street.
